name: Methodology statement
lead: The methodology statement for a design competition or a design-services RFP, structured on the buyer's scoring grid and built from your past projects and past statements.

project.title: Invited design competition: refurbishment and extension of Larkfield Primary School (fictional)
meta: Full design services, concept to handover

extracts.text: Quality is scored on the methodology statement (50%): understanding of a live school site (20%), team organisation and resources (15%), approach to programme and cost control (15%). Sustainability approach (10%). Fee (40%).
The methodology statement must not exceed 10 pages, appendices excluded.
Design duration, from concept to tender documents: 26 weeks maximum, excluding client sign-off periods.
Works take place on a live site: the school stays open throughout. Noisy or dusty works are limited to school holidays.
Extension: net-zero-ready target, embodied carbon capped at 500 kgCO2e/m². Refurbished areas: at least 40% lower final energy use.
Late delivery of design documents: liquidated damages of 0.1% of the stage fee per calendar day.
Target programme: extension structure from September 2027 to February 2028.
Hillcrest Nursery School (fictional): 1,200 m² extension on a live site, completed 2024, $3.7M, phased over three school holidays.
Claire Holden, partner architect (fictional), project lead; Keystone Engineering (structures and building services, fictional); Sonora Acoustics (fictional); in-house cost consultant.
Cost control: estimate at every stage, variance review as soon as an overrun exceeds 3%, client decision before moving to the next stage.
We propose to complete design from concept to tender documents in 30 weeks.

items.t: The school stays open throughout: we split the site into sealed zones, with a delivery route kept apart from children's routes.
Noisy and dusty works are scheduled in school holidays, as at Hillcrest, where works were phased over three holidays.
Design concept and site reading: [TO WRITE: architect only]. The tool structures; it does not design.
Project lead: {chef}, single point of contact for the client from concept to handover.
Compact team: architect, structures and building services engineers, acoustician and in-house cost consultant, involved from concept stage.
Hours per stage and per team member: [TO COMPLETE from your fee sheet].
Design from concept to tender documents in {duree} weeks, excluding client sign-off periods.
Cost tracked at every stage against the {env} budget: variance review from a 3% overrun, client decision before the next stage.
Document delivery dates held stage by stage: the late-delivery damages in the terms are built into our internal programme.
Extension designed to the net-zero-ready target and the 500 kgCO2e/m² embodied carbon cap; refurbished areas aim for 40% lower energy use, tracked by the engineers from concept stage.
Material choices and carbon figures: [TO COMPLETE with your real data].

contradictions.title: Design duration: your previous statement exceeds the competition maximum
contradictions.impact: A duration outside the rules can cost points or make the bid non-compliant.
contradictions.action: Use 26 weeks or less and adjust the internal programme.

contradictions.title: The brief contradicts itself: noisy works in holidays, but structure from September to February
contradictions.impact: The two requirements cannot both hold as written.
contradictions.action: Ask the client a clarification question before the deadline and propose a phasing in the statement.

contradictions.title: Construction budget: the statement quotes the brief's figure
